stem.text: A metal wire has length $5.2\,\text{m}$ and diameter $1.0\,\text{mm}$. The metal has Young modulus $360\,\text{GPa}$.
The wire is fixed at one end and a force is applied to the other end. The force extends the wire by $7.2\,\text{mm}$. The wire obeys Hooke's law.
What is the force applied to the wire?
